text: Ah, a traveler! Welcome to our village. I am the chief here.

children.text: Monsters have been appearing lately. There's a cave to the east — I fear that's where they're coming from. Could you help us?
responses: Maybe later, I need to prepare first.

children.text: Thank you, brave one! The cave entrance is at the eastern edge of the village. Be careful in there.
Of course, take your time. Come find me when you're ready.
Safe travels, then. But be wary — strange creatures have been spotted nearby.
